messages:
Maya (Design): dropped a new compact mock for the autoscaling panel: min/max, burst toggle, GPU pool selector, and the SLO slider. looking for quick UX + a11y review. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123
Alex (Product): saw it. request: make SLO feel approachable. maybe default to a "Balanced (100 ms)" preset with short helper text.
Samir (Eng): quick backend notes: GPU pools are limited to [g4, l4, a100]. dropdown needs to expose estimated tokens/sec and $/hr for each. we'll return numbers from the pools API.
Maya (Design): thinking of showing pool rows like: "g4 — ~600 qps · $2.80/hr" small text under the name. fits visually?
Leah (Accessibility): a11y pass: 1) ensure SLO slider supports keyboard arrow keys (1% step) and PgUp/PgDn (10%). 2) contrast for secondary labels is currently 3.6:1  need 4.5:1 for AA. 3) GPU dropdown should implement aria-activedescendant and be typeahead-friendly.
Maya (Design): thanks. i'll bump contrast and add keyboard notes in the spec. question on labels: show units as "ms"?
Alex (Product): always include units: "50 ms". non-technical PMs get confused otherwise.
Samir (Eng): also need a guardrail: if chosen SLO < 60 ms and pool is l4, show an inline note: "Selected latency not likely with this pool" and propose enabling burst or switching pool. We can surface achievable estimate from telemetry.
Maya (Design): draft guardrail copy: "Note: With this pool, expected p95 is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enable burst." Tone ok?
Leah (Accessibility): prefer neutral phrasing: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst." add role="status" so it is announced.
Jon (SRE): on burst: add tooltip: "Burst uses spare GPU capacity for short spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." Also ops wants telemetry: capacity.burst.triggered {team, pool, duration_s}.
Samir (Eng): noted for API. we'll emit that event when burst allocation succeeds.
Maya (Design): burst label options: "Enable burst capacity (for short spikes)" vs shorter "Enable burst (short spikes)". preference?
Alex (Product): longer is clearer in UI: "Enable burst capacity (for short traffic spikes)".
Leah (Accessibility): ensure label is programmatically associated via aria-labelledby.
Maya (Design): about min/max defaults — team suggests min=1, max=16. should we show a recommended band computed from org history? Alex?
Alex (Product): yes show "Recommended: min 2 — max 8" with a small apply button. reduces friction.
Samir (Eng): backend will provide /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest returning recommended_min, recommended_max, and rationale.
Maya (Design): modal explainer for "How min/max affect cost" includes example math. any must-have lines?
Jon (SRE): include migration behavior: if new min > current instances, UI must warn and require confirmation. show "Apply and migrate (may restart instances)" vs "Apply without migration (will scale when needed)".
Leah (Accessibility): modal must trap focus, have descriptive aria-label, and close control.
Maya (Design): i'll update figma with contrast fixes, a11y annotations, revised guardrail copy, burst tooltip text, recommended range UI, and inline cost estimate. will post link when done.
ops-bot: uploaded updated figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123?node-id=88 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): proposed acceptance criteria: 1) SLO slider keyboard accessible + labeled; 2) GPU pool rows show qps and $/hr and support typeahead; 3) burst toggle with tooltip + billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status when triggered; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply.
Samir (Eng): implementation ETA: 2 sprints. will coordinate API changes.
Maya (Design): thanks all  i'll push specs and the updated mock tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
